hardBreakevenVerification.Scope: PL_after(T, Q) >= 0 is verified at each applicable tail entry, with the actual fill, under the configured execution model; it is not re-verified afterwards.
Assumptions: upper recovery projection: Bid = T_up, Ask = T_up + 0.50 (the boundary itself is Bid = T_up; the actual zero-loss BE must stay at or below it)
lower recovery projection: Ask = T_down, Bid = T_down - 0.50 (the boundary itself is Ask = T_down; the actual zero-loss BE must stay at or above it)
financing is not supported (both swap rates are 0)
NotCovered: a spread at the boundary wider than the configured target spread
a change of the execution model between the entry and the target
